items.note: Loop 2 on the bytes after commit 7a1faf1d (task wording only; the starter, EDITOR_CFG, gating and inline python-scaffold@3 adapter are unchanged). Activity 4 (Write the hints into a signature, #activity-4) still carries a required authoring task in the functions.py lesson editor (fieldset #fned, goal "author", the only check for step 4). To pass, the learner must write the two collecting parameters (*args-style and **kwargs-style) into the describe signature, add type hints to the positional parameter, the defaulted parameter and the return, and write the top-level call that spreads the supplied list positionally and the supplied dict by keyword. That makes o2 and o3 construction tasks and requires the defaulted-parameter-with-hint form for o1. The reworded step no longer states the fills; it says what to produce and where its inputs come from. Completability: the parameter names are given by the starter return line; the collector forms are taught in activity 3 and shown in the Taught forms panel; the hint types can be derived from the supplied values and from the teaching (hint-before-default order, return hint before the colon, a tuple-returning example in Taught forms); the spreading call is taught in activity 3. So a learner can complete it from the page without the answer being stated. Residuals (not blocking): the positional/default parameter names and default value are prewritten, and no typed call passes keyword arguments in a chosen order (o1 keyword order is still covered by the activity-2 buttons and the predict activity). Static reading of the checker shows the return hint must be the plain built-in name, so a valid but more specific subscripted return hint gets only the generic "complete the annotated describe signature" Lesson check. Verified by static read of the current task, teaching, starter and checker rules; inline adapter run on the untouched starter and a placeholder-to-pass variant (both rejected; inline adapter byte-identical to lesson-editor/scaffold-adapter.js); JS-enabled Chromium (activity-4 timeline link and #activity-4 hash/popstate stay on activity 1, Continue hidden, starter Run leaves data-pep-completed=false); JS-disabled Chromium (.nojs-editor visible, editor chrome hidden). A passing completion was not exercised (no protected input written).
